summary: OpenUp is mental health platform to connect employees with psychologists and experts, founded in 2020. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: OpenUp is an Amsterdam mental well-being platform for employers, founded in 2020, and an IND recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Offers companies and their staff 1:1 check-ins, online courses, group sessions and mindfulness with well-being experts.
Takes a holistic approach linking mental and physical health through nutrition, sleep and stress.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (OpenUp Technologies B.V.).
Both current Amsterdam jobs (customer support internship and mid-level sales) don't require Dutch.

growth.text: Founded in Amsterdam in 2020; owned by Dutch holding OpenUp Group B.V.
